'''Hartwig''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Red Harvest" /> In [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Hartwig was attending the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] combat [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Xat Hracken]] that year, when the man succumbed to a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] that turned him into a [[Zombie/Legends|flesh-eating monster]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
